dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: そっ、とドアを開けた。
dialogues.en: I opened the door quietly.
dialogues.text: I opened the door quietly.

dialogues.jp: 「寝てるよな……って、なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "I know she's sleeping. But what's this?"
dialogues.text: "I know she's sleeping. But what's this?"

dialogues.jp:
鼻をくすぐるというか、むっ、とくるような桜
の匂い。
dialogues.en: There is a strong odor of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text: There is a strong odor of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けほ……ん……っ」
dialogues.en: "Cough..."
dialogues.text: "Cough..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Niisan..."
dialogues.text: "Niisan..."

dialogues.jp: ゆらり、とベッドから音夢が立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Nemu gets up from the bed unsteadily.
dialogues.text: Nemu gets up from the bed unsteadily.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？　あと、なんだこの匂いは？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? What is this smell, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? What is this smell, anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「来ないで……」
dialogues.en: "Don't come in."
dialogues.text: "Don't come in."

dialogues.jp:
ぴた、と音夢の声が瞬間接着剤のように働き、
足が床に張り付く。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I heard Nemu, I couldn't move as if my feet were
glued to the floor instantly.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I heard Nemu, I couldn't move as if my feet were
glued to the floor instantly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さくらの夢を見てたでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "You saw Sakura's dream, didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "You saw Sakura's dream, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp: すらり、と白い足がベッドから下りてくる。
dialogues.en: Her white, slender legs come down from the bed.
dialogues.text: Her white, slender legs come down from the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「え、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... yeah."
dialogues.text: "Uhh... yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんだ……やっぱり、兄さんのその和菓
　子の力ってさくらのためのモノだったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I see. You use the magic to make snacks only for Sakura,
don't you?"
dialogues.text:
"I see. You use the magic to make snacks only for Sakura,
don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前……和菓子って、どこまで俺のことを知っ
　てるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"You're talking about snacks, but how much do you think you
know about me?"
dialogues.text:
"You're talking about snacks, but how much do you think you
know about me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どこまでって……何年、兄妹やってると思っ
　てるのよ？」
dialogues.en: "How long do you think we've been brother and sister?"
dialogues.text: "How long do you think we've been brother and sister?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それにね……最近……兄さんのことが分かる
　の」
dialogues.en: "Also... lately... I've been able to feel what you feel. "
dialogues.text: "Also... lately... I've been able to feel what you feel. "

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「繋がってるっていうのかな？　身体よりも深
　くて温かいところで」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, I feel we're connected at a deeper level, not just
physically."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, I feel we're connected at a deeper level, not just
physically."

dialogues.jp:
シャツ１枚という姿で、音夢がそっと寄って来
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu gets closer. She's wearing nothing but a shirt.
dialogues.text: Nemu gets closer. She's wearing nothing but a shirt.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「気持ちとか、何を食べたいとか、どんな天気
　が好きかとか、なにに興味を持っているとか」
dialogues.en:
"I can tell how you feel, what you want to eat, what kind of
weather you like or what you're interested in."
dialogues.text:
"I can tell how you feel, what you want to eat, what kind of
weather you like or what you're interested in."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どんな夢を見ているか、とか」
dialogues.en: "And I can also tell what kind of dream you had."
dialogues.text: "And I can also tell what kind of dream you had."

dialogues.jp: 首元の鈴のように、ころころ、と音夢が微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu giggles musically, like a bell.
dialogues.text: Nemu giggles musically, like a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、兄さんは気づかないでしょ？　私の一
　方的な感覚なんだよね」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think you've noticed, have you? I think these
feelings are only on my side."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think you've noticed, have you? I think these
feelings are only on my side."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんの気持ちが私に向かってないから」
dialogues.en: "Because you aren't paying attention to me."
dialogues.text: "Because you aren't paying attention to me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前」

卒業式の夜のように、音夢の目が虚ろに揺れて
いる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's eyes look empty, like they did on the night of the
graduation ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's eyes look empty, like they did on the night of the
graduation ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、あんな魔女に……」
dialogues.en: "Why do you let the witch..."
dialogues.text: "Why do you let the witch..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これは、さくらが見ている夢だって気づかな
　いの兄さん？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you know this is the dream that Sakura is having,
niisan?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't you know this is the dream that Sakura is having,
niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うんん……気づけないのか」
dialogues.en: "I mean... Why can't you notice it?"
dialogues.text: "I mean... Why can't you notice it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おい、本当に変だぞ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you sound different!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you sound different!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって…………けほっ」
dialogues.en: "Because... cough!"
dialogues.text: "Because... cough!"

dialogues.jp: 口元を押さえて音夢が背を丸める。
dialogues.en: Nemu arches her back while covering her mouth.
dialogues.text: Nemu arches her back while covering her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
と、ぽろぽろ、と手のひらからなにかが零れ落
ちるのが見えた。
dialogues.en: I saw something dripping down from her hand.
dialogues.text: I saw something dripping down from her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……私なにを？」
dialogues.en: "What is it, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What is it, niisan?"

dialogues.jp:
そこまで呟いて、ごほごほ、と本格的に嫌な音
を立てて音夢が咳き込む。
dialogues.en: After she mutters, she starts coughing badly. It sounds bad.
dialogues.text: After she mutters, she starts coughing badly. It sounds bad.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の手からこぼれたものが、ひらひらと空気
に流されて、俺の足元に滑り込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
The stuff escaping from Nemu's hands comes fluttering down
to my feet.
dialogues.text:
The stuff escaping from Nemu's hands comes fluttering down
to my feet.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、これ……」
dialogues.en: "This is..."
dialogues.text: "This is..."

dialogues.jp: つまみあげたものは、桜の花びらだった？
dialogues.en: The thing I picked up was a cherry blossom petal.
dialogues.text: The thing I picked up was a cherry blossom petal.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が目を丸くして口元から手を離すと、ぼろ
ぼろ、と桜の花がこぼれ落ちる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, and cherry blossom
petals keeps spilling out of her mouth.
dialogues.text:
Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, and cherry blossom
petals keeps spilling out of her mouth.

dialogues.jp: そして、まるで血を見て貧血を起こしたように。
dialogues.en: As if she were having an attack of anemia,
dialogues.text: As if she were having an attack of anemia,

dialogues.jp: ばさっ、と床に倒れた。
dialogues.en: She faints and collapses to the floor.
dialogues.text: She faints and collapses to the floor.

dialogues.jp: ◆泣き虫音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Crybaby Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Crybaby Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
慌てて音夢の部屋に入ると、厳しい制止の声に
足をとめられる。
dialogues.en:
When I went to Nemu's room in a rush, I was stunned by her
words.
dialogues.text:
When I went to Nemu's room in a rush, I was stunned by her
words.

dialogues.jp:
さくらとの仲に嫉妬する音夢が、俺と心が繋がっ
ていて、同じ夢を見るのだと呟く――俺の力の
ことも知っていると。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was jealous of the relationship Sakura and I have. She
said we're connected at a deeper level and she saw my
dreams... and she said she knows about my magic power, too.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was jealous of the relationship Sakura and I have. She
said we're connected at a deeper level and she saw my
dreams... and she said she knows about my magic power, too.

dialogues.jp:
そして、苦しそうに咳き込むと、身体から桜の
花びらをこぼしながら、音夢は昏倒した。
dialogues.en:
Then, after she started coughing badly, she spilled cherry
blossom petals out of her body and collapsed.
dialogues.text:
Then, after she started coughing badly, she spilled cherry
blossom petals out of her body and collapsed.
